selection_rule: Complete registered authority records and predeclared complete experimental target pages; no external wording, value, product, mechanism or outcome may select a Fold law, grammar or survivor.
custody_rule: Capture each source once for the family; preserve every favourable, adverse, absent, mismatched and unresolved row; bind each claim-specific comparison to distinct preregistered target identifiers before outcomes are opened.
native_arithmetic_boundary: External inscriptions may contain conventional zero, signed, decimal or continuum notation. They remain downstream measurement records. Native proof arithmetic admits only exact positive whole/fractional relations and EmptyOne for structural absence.
